Sensitivity.meaning: Ability to correctly identify diseased patients
Sensitivity.rule: SnNout: High Sensitivity, Negative test rules OUT disease

Specificity.meaning: Ability to correctly identify non-diseased individuals
Specificity.rule: SpPin: High Specificity, Positive test rules IN disease

PPV.meaning: Probability of disease given positive test
PPV.prevalence_dependency: Strongly decreases as disease prevalence decreases

NPV.meaning: Probability of no disease given negative test

Likelihood_Ratio_Positive_LR_plus.clinical_utility: > 10 very strong rule-in, 5-10 moderate, 2-5 small, 1 uninformative

Likelihood_Ratio_Negative_LR_minus.clinical_utility: < 0.1 very strong rule-out, 0.1-0.2 moderate, 0.2-0.5 small, 1 uninformative

ROC_AUC.description: Plot of Sensitivity (y) vs 1-Specificity (x) across all thresholds

metrics.Youden_Index_J: Sensitivity + Specificity - 1 (Optimal cutoff balancing Sens and Spec)

bayesian_nomogram.step_1: Pre-test Odds = Pre-test Probability / (1 - Pre-test Probability)
bayesian_nomogram.step_2: Post-test Odds = Pre-test Odds * Likelihood Ratio
bayesian_nomogram.step_3: Post-test Probability = Post-test Odds / (1 + Post-test Odds)
bayesian_nomogram.fagan_nomogram: Graphical tool aligning Pre-test Probability, LR, and Post-test Probability
